import numpy as np


def nb_predict(x, stats, priors):
    best, best_score = None, -1
    for c, (mean, std) in stats.items():
        pdf = np.exp(-((x - mean) ** 2) / (2 * std ** 2)) / (std * np.sqrt(2 * np.pi))
        score = priors[c] * pdf
        if score > best_score:
            best, best_score = c, score
    return best
